title: Field techniques: controlled crosses, good seed and fair trials

say: Field techniques: controlled crosses, good seed and fair trials.
This is the video for module 2 of Agricultural Hybridization and Crop Improvement.
Breeding is controlled pollination. You choose the mother and the father, and block all other pollen.

say: Step 1. Cover the ear shoot with a shoot bag as soon as it appears, before any silk comes out.

panel.heading: Hand pollination in maize
items: Bag the ear shoot before silks show
Cut back the silks, re-bag at once
Same afternoon, bag the father tassel
Pour on the silks, cover the ear

say: Step 2. When silks emerge, cut them straight across in the afternoon, and re-bag at once.

panel.heading: Hand pollination in maize
items: Bag the ear shoot before silks show
Cut back the silks, re-bag at once
Same afternoon, bag the father tassel
Pour on the silks, cover the ear

say: Step 3. The same afternoon, cover the father's tassel with a tassel bag and staple it.

panel.heading: Hand pollination in maize
items: Bag the ear shoot before silks show
Cut back the silks, re-bag at once
Same afternoon, bag the father tassel
Pour on the silks, cover the ear

say: Step 4. Next morning, after the dew dries, bend the tassel and tap the bag so pollen falls inside.

panel.heading: Hand pollination in maize
items: Bag the ear shoot before silks show
Cut back the silks, re-bag at once
Same afternoon, bag the father tassel
Pour on the silks, cover the ear

say: Step 5. Lift the shoot bag quickly, pour the pollen over the silks, and cover the ear with the tassel bag.

panel.heading: Hand pollination in maize
items: Bag the ear shoot before silks show

say: Step 6. Write the cross on the bag and a tag, mother first, with the date.
For tomato, remove the anthers from a bud before it opens. That is called emasculation.

panel.rule: Write the cross on the bag, mother first, and leave it to harvest.

say: For example, Funke grows 0.5 ha of white OPV maize in Oyo State. She needs 10 kg of seed, and saves 15 kg.

panel.heading: Funke improves her OPV by selection
items: Needs 10 kg seed; plans to save 15 kg
Uses grain from the middle of each cob

say: She avoids the outer four rows.

panel.heading: Funke improves her OPV by selection
items: Needs 10 kg seed; plans to save 15 kg
Uses grain from the middle of each cob

say: Before harvest, in the field, she ribbons upright, disease-free plants with good husk cover.

panel.heading: Funke improves her OPV by selection
items: Needs 10 kg seed; plans to save 15 kg
Uses grain from the middle of each cob

say: She marks at least 200 plants. The common mistake is choosing from too few plants, or picking big cobs at the barn.

panel.heading: Funke improves her OPV by selection

say: She uses grain from the middle of each good cob.

say: In Nigeria, the National Agricultural Seeds Council, NASC, registers seed companies and certifies seed. Check the label for the variety, lot number, test date, producer and any treatment.

panel.heading: A good label and warning signs
right: No lot number or test date

say: Be careful with loose seed, missing lot numbers, very low prices or re-stitched bags. Keep the receipt and the empty bag, and report fake seed to NASC.

panel.heading: A good label and warning signs
right: No lot number or test date

say: Before planting, count out 100 seeds at random.

panel.heading: The 100-seed germination test
items: Lay them on damp tissue or cloth
Keep moist and warm about 7 days

say: Lay them on damp tissue or cloth, and roll it loosely.

panel.heading: The 100-seed germination test
items: Lay them on damp tissue or cloth
Keep moist and warm about 7 days

say: Keep it moist and warm, for about 7 days for maize.

panel.heading: The 100-seed germination test
items: Lay them on damp tissue or cloth
Keep moist and warm about 7 days

say: Count the seeds with a healthy root and shoot. For example, Ifeoma in Anambra counted 86 out of 100. That is 86%.

panel.heading: The 100-seed germination test
items: Lay them on damp tissue or cloth
Keep moist and warm about 7 days

say: So for 1 hectare she needs about 18.6 kg, and keeps 20 kg.

panel.heading: The 100-seed germination test
items: Lay them on damp tissue or cloth

say: If germination is low, many advisers suggest buying fresh seed rather than simply sowing more.

say: Seed coated with a coloured powder or liquid has usually been dressed with a pesticide. Never eat it, sell it as grain, or feed it to animals.

panel.heading: Treated seed is poison, not food

cards.d: Never cook, sell as grain or feed to animals seed with a coloured coating.
Wear gloves, do not touch your face, wash hands with soap after planting.
Away from children and livestock. Never reuse empty seed bags for food.

say: Wear gloves when handling it, do not touch your face, and wash your hands with soap after planting.

say: A single comparison can be fooled by a wet corner. Step 1. Choose your usual variety, the check, plus one or two new ones.

panel.heading: Lay out a replicated trial
items: Your usual seed plus 1 or 2 new
4 rows of 5 m; harvest the 2 middle

say: Step 2. Make three blocks across any slope. Each block holds every variety once.

panel.heading: Lay out a replicated trial
items: Your usual seed plus 1 or 2 new
4 rows of 5 m; harvest the 2 middle

say: Step 3. In each block, draw folded papers to decide the order.

panel.heading: Lay out a replicated trial
items: Your usual seed plus 1 or 2 new
4 rows of 5 m; harvest the 2 middle

say: Step 4. Plant 4 rows of 5 m. The outer rows are borders. Harvest only the 2 middle rows, the net plot.

panel.heading: Lay out a replicated trial
items: Your usual seed plus 1 or 2 new
4 rows of 5 m; harvest the 2 middle

say: Step 5. Record plant stand, days to 50% silking, disease scores and lodging.

panel.heading: Lay out a replicated trial
items: Your usual seed plus 1 or 2 new
4 rows of 5 m; harvest the 2 middle

say: Manage every plot the same, so only the variety differs.

panel.heading: Lay out a replicated trial
items: Your usual seed plus 1 or 2 new
4 rows of 5 m; harvest the 2 middle
panel.rule: Same planting day, spacing, fertiliser and weeding for every plot.

say: For example, Rukayat in Kaduna harvests a net plot of 7.5 m2. Variety A gives 4.2 kg of grain at 20% moisture.

panel.heading: Rukayat measures her yields
items: Net plot: 7.5 m2; grain 4.2 kg at 20%
Scale up: about 5,267 kg per hectare
A wins in every block, by 923 kg/ha

say: Wetter grain weighs more, so she corrects to 15% moisture: 3.95 kg.

say: To remember. Bag the ear early. Select from many plants in the field. Test germination. Treat dressed seed as poison. And replicate, randomise and correct moisture.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Bag the ear before silks appear
Select seed in the field, from many plants
Treated seed is poison, never food
